title: Effect of seasonal variability of aerosols in radiative forcing and Indian summer monsoon rainfall over south Asia during ENSO events
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1834-1847
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00140D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sakshi Sharma, Arun Chakraborty
Seasonal variability of aerosols has a direct impact on ISM rainfall and ADRF during ENSO events over South Asia. Notable spatial variability of net ADRF at the surface and top of the atmosphere was observed during the JJAS season of El-Niño years.
